statement: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller must notify the breach to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons; where notification is not made within 72 hours, it must be accompanied by reasons for the delay (GDPR Article 33(1)).
caveat: A processor must notify the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2)), the notification's minimum contents are set by Art. 33(3), information may be provided in phases (Art. 33(4)), and which authority is competent follows Article 55; the risk assessment that can excuse notification is the controller's to defend, and EDPB guidance refines when a controller 'becomes aware'. Verified against the Official Journal text on the Publications Office cellar (eur-lex.europa.eu was unreachable to automated fetches at check time). This repo does not assess breach risk or run the clock.
